scripts.db:migrate:local: for db in sms-d1-identity sms-d1-students sms-d1-academics sms-d1-attendance sms-d1-performance sms-d1-finance sms-d1-timetable sms-d1-audit; do npx wrangler d1 migrations apply "$db" --local --force || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate:prod: test "$CONFIRM_REMOTE_D1_MIGRATE" = "true" || { echo 'Refusing remote migration without CONFIRM_REMOTE_D1_MIGRATE=true'; exit 1; }; for db in sms-d1-identity sms-d1-students sms-d1-academics sms-d1-attendance sms-d1-performance sms-d1-finance sms-d1-timetable sms-d1-audit; do npx wrangler d1 migrations apply "$db" --remote || exit 1; done
scripts.db:seed:local: npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-identity --local --file=./seeds/01_identity.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-students --local --file=./seeds/02_students.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-academics --local --file=./seeds/03_academics.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-attendance --local --file=./seeds/04_attendance.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-performance --local --file=./seeds/05_performance.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-finance --local --file=./seeds/06_finance.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-timetable --local --file=./seeds/07_timetable.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sms-d1-audit --local --file=./seeds/08_audit.sql
scripts.db:init:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:verify:local: for db in sms-d1-identity sms-d1-students sms-d1-academics sms-d1-attendance sms-d1-performance sms-d1-finance sms-d1-timetable sms-d1-audit; do echo "=== $db ==="; npx wrangler d1 execute "$db" --local --command="SELECT COUNT(*) AS table_count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT IN ('_cf_KV', 'd1_migrations');" || exit 1; done
